claims: The Chicago Cubs open the 2026 MLB season at home against the Washington Nationals at Wrigley Field, Chicago.
The Chicago Cubs' opening day game is on Thursday, March 26, 2026.
The first pitch for the Chicago Cubs' opening day game is at 1:20 P.M. CT.
Left-hander Matthew Boyd is slated to make the opening start for the Chicago Cubs.
Dylan Carlson is confirmed for the Chicago Cubs' 26-man roster.
Dylan Carlson was named to the roster following strong spring training performance, according to MLB.com.
Outfield prospect Kevin Alcántara was optioned to Triple-A Iowa.
Cubs Insider notes that the Chicago Cubs' roster includes Pete Crow-Armstrong, Nico Hoerner, Dansby Swanson, and Ian Happ.
The Chicago Cubs had a 92-win, postseason-contending performance from 2025, according to Bleed Cubbie Blue.
